title: Ultimate Exorcist Kiyoshi
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Orphaned when demons killed his parents, Kiyoshi Harai trained to become the strongest exorcist ever and graduated top of the Exorcist Academy, but he is painfully shy. Assigned to a branch office hidden in a Chinese restaurant run by his mentor, he fights demons with sun-and-moon techniques, keeps a list of 100 things to do in high school, and works alongside a rival with holy-water bullets and a classmate partnered with a friendly amnesiac demon. An action comedy in Weekly Shonen Jump.
life_message: Strength exists to protect the weak, and even the strongest person needs friends and ordinary joys.
